test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Army officers are given training to __decipher__ the secret messages sent during war time.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Decode**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"decipher"** means to interpret or make sense of something, especially a code or difficult text. (समझना या हल करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The archaeologists managed to decipher the ancient script on the stone tablet.
 
 
• **"Decode"** refers to converting a coded message into a readable format. It is a synonym for decipher. (कोड को हल करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The intelligence agency worked tirelessly to decode the intercepted enemy communication.
